name: claude-brain-kit
description: Your Claude, the same collaborator on every device — a git-backed personal brain. Plugins: brain (session sync, writes, skills) and brain-voice (Voice Brain MCP).

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Session-start auto-pull of your brain clone, concurrency-safe writes (brain-write.sh), and the /brain:setup, /brain:todos, /brain:idea, write and profile skills.

plugins.name: brain-voice
plugins.description: Registers your self-hosted Voice Brain MCP server (tools/voice-brain) in Claude Code. Install only if `claude mcp list` does not already show it.
